name: OmniDrop: Share Files Across Devices
summary:
# OmniDrop for Meta Quest

OmniDrop brings your file inbox to Meta Quest in a focused 2D panel app.

Sign in with your email to access files shared with your OmniDrop account. Download received files, open supported files, or upload files from your headset using the system file picker.

## Features

- Email sign-in with one-time verification code
- Inbox for received files
- Download progress and cancel controls
- Open downloaded files with compatible apps
- Upload one or multiple files
- Optional ZIP compr
